tools.maps_around_search: (args) => { const r = args.radius || '1000'; const c = MOCK.pois.filter((p) => p.__straightMeters <= Number(r)); return JSON.stringify({ pois: c.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, address: p.address, typecode: p.typecode })) }, null, 2); }
tools.maps_text_search: (args) => JSON.stringify({ pois: MOCK.pois.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, address: p.address, typecode: p.typecode })) }, null, 2)
tools.maps_search_detail: (args) => { const p = MOCK.pois.find((x) => x.id === args.id); if (!p) return JSON.stringify({ error: 'POI 不存在' }); return JSON.stringify({ id: p.id, name: p.name, location: p.location, address: p.address, business_area: p.business_area, city: '杭州市', type: p.type, alias: p.alias, biz_ext: p.biz_ext }, null, 2); }
tools.maps_direction_walking: (args) => { const dest = MOCK.pois.find((x) => x.location === args.destination); if (!dest) return JSON.stringify({ error: '终点坐标无法匹配' }); const w = MOCK.walking[dest.id]; return JSON.stringify({ route: { origin: { location: args.origin }, destination: { location: args.destination }, paths: [{ distance: String(w.distance), duration: String(w.duration), steps: w.steps.map((s) => ({ instruction: s.instruction, road: s.road, distance: String(s.distance), duration: String(s.duration) })) }] } }, null, 2); }
tools.maps_geo: (args) => JSON.stringify({ location: MOCK.start.location, address: MOCK.start.name }, null, 2)
tools.maps_distance: (args) => JSON.stringify({ results: [{ origin_id: '起点', dest_id: args.destination, distance: '0', duration: '0' }] }, null, 2)
tools.maps_regeocode: (args) => JSON.stringify({ addressComponent: { city: '杭州市', district: '拱墅区' } }, null, 2)
